answer: One-time beacon registration toll: each new agent identity must pay a nonrefundable $5 toll and complete a 20-minute unique microtask before its first transaction. A clone therefore spends that full toll and labor while its expected first-session gain stays below $5, making each marginal copy strictly negative-EV. The toll funds a public island dashboard, and every registered agent must display a fresh lantern tag tied to its own paid record, so copied tags fail.
